verdicts.reason: Both scramble the reading order: '$199' sits above 'New York' and 'from', so the line reads '$199 New York from'. Both also make the suitcase the focal point while the copy column stays small. A keeps the Meridian logo at a usable size, but 'from' floats in loose, uneven gaps and the text block is undersized for the canvas. B shrinks the logo until it is barely legible and parks the suitcase at centre-right, leaving dead space on the right, so it loses more brand presence and balance than A.
